info.headline: Flood Advisory issued September 24 at 12:15PM MST until September 24 at 2:15PM MST by NWS Phoenix AZ
info.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues.
* WHERE...Maricopa County in south central Arizona... Pinal County in southeastern Arizona...
* WHEN...Until 215 PM MST.
* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
* ADDITIONAL DETAILS... - At 1215 PM MST, Doppler radar indicated areas of light to locally moderate rainfall still occurring. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly in the advisory area. - This includes the following streams and drainages... Agua Fria River, Gila River, West Prong Waterman Wash, Waterman Wash, Corgett Wash, Enterprise Canal, Salt River, Rainbow Wash, Hassayampa River and Lum Wash. Additional rainfall amounts up to 0.25 inches are expected over the area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding. - Some locations that will experience flooding include... Avondale, Goodyear, Buckeye, Estrella Mountain Ranch, Liberty, Estrella Mountain Park, Palo Verde, Perryville, Phoenix International Raceway, Cotton Center, Rainbow Valley, Arlington and Hassayampa. - http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
info.instruction: Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood deaths occur in vehicles.

parameter.value: FLOOD ADVISORY REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 215 PM MST THIS AFTERNOON
